scope: Only world manifests explicitly pinned to global-story-bible-v1. Public narrative authoring contract; does not publish or import private world content.

revisionPolicy.upgrade: new version and explicit author review; never silently reinterpret a pinned session

rules.requirement: Player observation, lawful travel, dialogue and neutral continuation remain possible without a compulsory academic challenge.
Learning opportunities require authorized public scene cues, approved enrolled concepts and player consent; do not fabricate measurements or mastery.
NPC location, testimony, memory and relationships follow committed causes; rumors and player claims do not become confirmed facts by narration.
Only server-validated committed actions change world state; previews, drafts and DM prose never create effects.
Narration reveals only currently authorized player-visible information; private lore, NPC motives and future outcomes remain private.
Meaningful choices retain lawful alternatives and perceptible consequences; backtracking does not erase committed costs or history.
World-owned references stay within the selected world and pinned exact content revisions; never fall back to latest or another world.
Generated side quests are proposals until separately reviewed and published; academic correctness alone does not commit a game action.

limitations: These are narrative authoring and import-binding rules, not evidence of production enforcement, model quality or deployed content.

lineage.policy: Legacy draft remains unchanged for audit; new imports use global-story-bible-v1. These two version strings are not aliases.
